GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (7L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken @ 500m. Chasing Two Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & made some ground until ran out of room late. # Never a chance.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 150m was checked and directed out abruptly to avoid heels. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding revealed it to have a slow recovery. When questioned rider stated that he was asked to ride the horse conservatively. He said that after settling at the rear of the field, with there being a strong tempo, Savoca dropped the bridle after the 1000m and could not hold a position closer to the field. He added that the gelding then closed off satisfactorily in the home straight although it lost momentum when checked near the 150m.
